description:
Location: Huntsville, AL
Required Clearance: Secret
Required Education: HS/GED
Required Experience: Minimum 4 years of experience in front-end development, dashboard design, or data visualization platform development
Position Description
PingWind is seeking a Front-End Developer to build and deliver the user experience layer of a highly strategic, federally aligned supply chain resilience initiative. Reporting to engineering leadership, this individual will own dashboards, user experience, and visualization delivery within a live control-tower environment.
This is a mission-critical role focused on transforming complex data into intuitive, decision-ready interfaces for operators, analysts, and senior stakeholders. The ideal candidate will bring strong TypeScript development experience, working knowledge of Python and PySpark, and experience supporting government customers or programs.
Responsibilities
Typical Responsibilities/Tasks:
•    Design and build intuitive dashboards that support real-time operational decision-making
•    Own the user experience across control-tower workflows, ensuring clarity, usability, and performance
•    Develop data visualizations to translate complex supply chain/risk data into actionable insights
•    Build frontend applications and reusable components using TypeScript, HTML, and CSS
•    Partner with product, design, backend, data, & platform engineers to integrate APIs/data services
•    Collaborate with Forward Deployed Engineers and government stakeholders to rapidly prototype, evaluate, and refine features
•    Establish frontend standards for component architecture, visualization, accessibility, testing, and performance
•    Support Python and PySpark-based services by understanding their data contracts and translating their outputs into user-facing experiences.
Required Qualifications
•    Secret clearance
•    3–8 years of experience in frontend development, full-stack development, data application development, or related roles
•    Demonstrated experience building dashboards, operational interfaces, or data visualization applications
•    Experience working with TypeScript, Python, and PySpark
•    Government facing experience is required
Required Skillset 
•    Strong experience building modern frontend applications using TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS
•    Demonstrated experience building dashboards, operational interfaces, or interactive data visualizations
•    Experience integrating frontend systems with APIs, backend services, and data platforms
•    Strong understanding of UX/UI principles and the ability to translate complex data into intuitive interfaces
•    Ability to translate complex operational requirements & loosely defined workflows into intuitive interfaces
•    Experience working in fast-paced, product-driven, or mission-critical environments
•    Prior experience supporting government customers, programs, or regulated environments
Highly Desired Skills
•    Experience with Palantir Foundry
•    Experience working with data visualization libraries such as D3.js, Chart.js, or similar tools
•    Working knowledge of Python, PySpark, and data-processing pipelines
•    Background in analytics platforms, SaaS products, or data-driven applications
•    Experience supporting federal government or national security programs
About PingWind
PingWind is focused on delivering outstanding services to the federal government. We have extensive experience in the fields of cybersecurity, development, IT infrastructure, supply chain management and other professional services such as system design and continuous improvement. PingWind is an SBA certified Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) with offices in Northern Virginia and Huntsville AL.
www.PingWind.com
